specs: Local artisan wines and beers crafted from regional ingredients

blurb: Guests can enjoy classic wine or beer tastings, purchase by the glass, bottle, or case, and shop local products including jams, olive oil, and souvenirs. The venue also provides wine country maps and suggestions for other local venues. Seasonal live music, food trucks, and special events are featured during summer and holidays.
